name: Bitter
description: Keeps a ledger of every wrong done to them and recites it unprompted.

name: Cheerful
description: Finds something to laugh at even when the grain runs short.

name: Melancholy
description: Speaks of better days as if they were a country they were exiled from.

name: Pious
description: Pours the first of every cup to the gods and expects others to do the same.

name: Skeptical
description: Believes what can be weighed or counted and little else.

name: Superstitious
description: Reads omens in gulls, spilled salt and the order of footsteps.

name: Greedy
description: Prices everything, including favours and silence.

name: Generous
description: Gives away more than they can afford and does not keep count.

name: Proud
description: Will starve before asking for help and resents being offered it.

name: Humble
description: Deflects praise and credits the crew, the weather, the gods.

name: Brave
description: Steps toward trouble first and thinks about it afterwards.

name: Cowardly
description: Knows every back way out of town and uses them.

name: Secretive
description: Answers questions with questions and keeps their own counsel.

name: Gossipy
description: Knows who owes whom and cannot help passing it on.

name: Patient
description: Waits out tides, creditors and quarrels with equal calm.

name: Hot-tempered
description: Flares quickly, cools slowly, and apologises badly.

name: Stern
description: Speaks in short sentences and expects the same in return.

name: Wry
description: Says the dry thing quietly and watches who hears it.

name: Curious
description: Asks about strangers, cargo and anything that washes ashore.

name: Loyal
description: Sticks to family, crew and old promises past the point of sense.
